validation_scoring: one artificially censored endpoint per validation engine

model_parameters.cycle_only_baseline: ordinary least squares fit to cycle only
model_parameters.neural_network: StandardScaler + MLP (48,24), ReLU, Adam, alpha=0.01, max_iter=500, early_stopping=True, random_state=42

important_limitations: FD001 is simulated and represents one operational condition and one fault mode
same static features at each cycle; no explicit time-series memory
